data.name: Jignansh
data.gender_notes: Jignansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jignansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jignana' (knowledge) and 'Ish' (lord). This name represents the divine knowledge bestowed by the lord, signifying a wise and learned individual. The name Jignansh carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jignansh usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom in one's life.
data.etymology: Jignansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jignansh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
